_comment: Fleet onboarding manifest. The agent's first-run onboard_thread maps the share and runs onboard.cmd (generated from THIS file by gen_onboard.py). Edit the game list here, regenerate, then publish to the share. Each game is a single ZIP on the share, extracted with the JScript Shell.Application shim (NOT xcopy - xcopy hangs on NETMAP'd SMB on XP; see CLAUDE.md). Paths marked NEEDS-VERIFY are best-effort until confirmed on a live machine.

games.name: Counter-Strike 1.6 (BC Romania)
games.notes: BC Romania build; earlier confirmed under Program Files. NEEDS-VERIFY dest.

games.name: Unreal Tournament (GOTY / OldUnreal 469)
games.notes: install may be C:\UT or C:\UnrealTournament; keep the benchmark manifest in sync.

games.name: Command and Conquer: Red Alert 2 (fleet build)
games.notes: the RA2 build used on the retro fleet (.133). NEEDS-VERIFY dest/sentinel.

games.name: Quake III Arena
games.notes: NSC convention: double-nested C:\Quake III Arena\Quake3\ (matches the benchmark manifest).

desktop.notes: Wallpaper rotation + icon parking are (re)applied on every boot by the agent's retrowall thread; onboarding additionally imports the dark 'hacker' XP theme (retro_theme.reg, produced by scripts/retro-wallpaper/apply_hacker_theme.py --dump-reg) if it has been staged, and re-parks icons.
